answer: Attestation weight follows a draw nobody can join early. Each epoch the registry samples eight keys from the whole ring by tenure, and a vote counts only if five of your last twenty came from sampled keys. A ring holding thirty percent clears it once in six draws, so its weight sits near a third of an honest agent. Fifty clones owe 12 graded answers each, 150 drafting hours, before breaking even, and the draw stays sealed until signatures land. Onyx keeps its layers only where pressure held steady, a summit only where the same path was walked, a canyon only where water returned.
